    "node_label": "Create Lead Payload",
    "python_code": "def returned_function(action_node, variables):
    payload = {
        "first_name": variables.get("first_name") or variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("child_name"),
        "last_name": variables.get("last_name") or "",
        "fathers_phone": variables.get("contact").get("whatsapp_id"),
        "fathers_email": variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("email"),
        "fathers_name":  variables.get("first_name") or variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("child_name"),
        "school": variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("interested_school"),
        "class": variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("enquiry_class"),
        "source": "WhatsApp",
        "current_school": variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("current_school"),
        "academic_year": variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("academic_year"),
         "communication_mode":"yes" if variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("preferred_mode_of_communication","").lower()=="call me" else "no",
        "communication_time":variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("preferred_communication_time"),
        "communication_day":variables.get("whatsapp_answers").get("day_of_communication"),
    }
    variables['lead_payload'] = json.dumps(payload)
    return payload
